function.description: This function is used to create a recommendation model using a given user data and an algorithm type Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_data.description: A data frame of user ratings. Rows represent users, columns represent items, and entries represent user ratings for items

algorithm.description: The algorithm to be used for creating the recommendation model. Collaborative filtering, content-based filtering and hybrid filtering.

matrix_factorization.description: Optional parameter to indicate whether matrix factorization should be used. Default is False.

Below is a **complete, practical roadmap** for building a modern, production‑ready frontend for an e‑commerce site. It covers everything from planning and design to deployment, testing, and maintenance. Feel free to skip sections that you already know or adapt the stack to your team’s preferences. --- ## 1. Planning & Requirements | Step | What to do | Why it matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **Define core features** | Product catalog, search, filters, product detail, cart, checkout, user auth, reviews, wishlist, admin panel, analytics | Sets scope and informs tech choices | | **Identify target audience** | Mobile‑first, desktop, international users, accessibility needs | Influences design & performance decisions | | **Create user stories** | “As a shopper, I want to filter by price so I can find affordable items.” | Drives UI/UX design and testing | | **Set KPIs** | Conversion rate, average order value, cart abandonment, page load time | Guides optimization focus | --- ## 2. Wireframing & Prototyping | Tool | Use case | |------|----------| | **Figma / Sketch / Adobe XD** | Create low‑to‑high fidelity wireframes | | **Storybook** | Build a component library in isolation | | **InVision / Marvel** | Interactive prototypes for stakeholder review | **Tip:** Keep a design system (colors, typography, spacing) consistent across all screens. --- ## 3. Choose Your Tech Stack | Layer | Options | Recommendation | |-------|---------|----------------| | **Framework** | React, Vue, Angular | **React** (most ecosystem) | | **State Management** | Redux, Zustand, Recoil, Context API | **Redux Toolkit** + **RTK Query** for API calls | | **Routing** | React Router, Next.js (SSR), Remix | **Next.js** (SSR + SSG + API routes) | | **Styling** | CSS Modules, Styled‑Components, Tailwind CSS | **Tailwind CSS** (utility‑first, fast prototyping) | | **Component Library** | Material‑UI, Ant Design, Chakra UI | **Chakra UI** (accessibility out‑of‑the‑box) | | **Form Handling** | Formik, React Hook Form | **React Hook Form** (lightweight) | | **Testing** | Jest + React Testing Library, Cypress | Jest for unit, Cypress for E2E | | **Build Tool** | Vite, Webpack, Next.js built‑in | **Next.js** (handles bundling, SSR, SSG) | | **Deployment** | Vercel, Netlify, AWS Amplify, Docker | **Vercel** (native Next.js support) | | **CI/CD** | GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI | GitHub Actions (free, integrated) | | **Analytics** | Google Analytics, Plausible, Segment | **Google Analytics 4** + **Hotjar** | | **Monitoring** | Sentry, LogRocket | **Sentry** (error tracking) | | **Performance** | Lighthouse, Web Vitals | Lighthouse audits in CI | --- ## 4. Project Structure (Next.js + Tailwind + Chakra) ``` my-ecommerce/ ├─ public/ │ ├─ images/ │ └─ favicon.ico ├─ src/ │ ├─ components/ │ │ ├─ ui/ # Chakra components │ │ ├─ layout/ # Header, Footer, Sidebar │ │ └─ product/ # ProductCard, ProductDetail │ ├─ pages/ │ │ ├─ api/ # Next.js API routes (optional) │ │ ├─ _app.tsx │ │ ├─ index.tsx │ │ ├─ product/ │ │ │ └─ [slug].tsx │ │ ├─ cart.tsx │ │ └─ checkout.tsx │ ├─ hooks/ │ ├─ store/ │ │ ├─ slices/ │ │ └─ store.ts │ ├─ utils/ │ ├─ styles/ │ │ └─ globals.css │ └─ types/ ├─ .env.local ├─ tailwind.config.js ├─ postcss.config.js ├─ next.config.js ├─ package.json └─ README.md ``` --- ## 5. Core Components & Features ### 5.1 Product Listing ```tsx // src/components/product/ProductCard.tsx import { Box, Image, Text, Button } from "@chakra-ui/react"; import Link from "next/link"; export const ProductCard = ({ product }) => ( {product.title} ${product.price} ); ``` ### 5.2 Cart & Checkout ```tsx // src/store/slices/cartSlice.ts import { createSlice, PayloadAction } from "@reduxjs/toolkit"; interface CartItem { id: string; quantity: number; } const cartSlice = createSlice({ name: "cart", initialState: [] as CartItem[], reducers: { addItem(state, action: PayloadAction) { const existing = state.find((i) => i.id === action.payload.id); if (existing) existing.quantity += action.payload.quantity; else state.push(action.payload); }, removeItem(state, action: PayloadAction) { return state.filter((i) => i.id !== action.payload); }, clearCart(state) { return []; }, }, }); export const { addItem, removeItem, clearCart } = cartSlice.actions; export default cartSlice.reducer; ``` ### 5.3 API Integration (RTK Query) ```ts // src/store/api/productsApi.ts import { createApi, fetchBaseQuery } from "@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react"; export const productsApi = createApi({ reducerPath: "productsApi", baseQuery: fetchBaseQuery({ baseUrl: "/api" }), endpoints: (builder) => ({ getProducts: builder.query({ query: () => "/products", }), getProductBySlug: builder.query({ query: (slug) => `/products/${slug}`, }), }), }); export const { useGetProductsQuery, useGetProductBySlugQuery } = productsApi; ``` --- ## 6. Routing & Navigation - **Next.js** handles file‑based routing. - Use `next/link` for client‑side navigation. - For protected routes (checkout, account), create a higher‑order component or use `next-auth`. ```tsx // src/components/layout/Header.tsx import Link from "next/link"; import { Flex, Box, Button } from "@chakra-ui/react"; export const Header = () => ( Shop ); ``` --- ## 7. Styling & Design System ### 7.1 Tailwind + Chakra - **Tailwind** for utility classes (spacing, colors). - **Chakra UI** for accessible components. - Combine by wrapping Chakra components with Tailwind classes or using Chakra’s `sx` prop. ```tsx ... ``` ### 7.2 Dark Mode ```tsx // next.config.js module.exports = { future: { webpack5: true, }, webpack(config) { config.resolve.alias["@chakra-ui/system"] = require.resolve("@chakra-ui/system"); return config; }, }; ``` Use Chakra’s `useColorMode` hook to toggle. --- ## 8. Accessibility (WCAG 2.1) | Practice | How | |----------|-----| | Semantic HTML | Use `
`, `
`, `
`, `
` | | ARIA labels | `aria-label="Add to cart"` on buttons | | Keyboard navigation | Ensure focus states, `tabIndex` | | Alt text | Provide descriptive `alt` for images | | Contrast | Use Chakra’s color mode utilities | Run Lighthouse accessibility audit in CI. --- ## 9. Performance Optimizations | Technique | Implementation | |-----------|----------------| | **Image Optimization** | Next.js `next/image` component | | **Code Splitting** | Dynamic imports (`next/dynamic`) | | **Lazy Loading** | `loading="lazy"` on images, `IntersectionObserver` for components | | **Prefetching** | `next/link` prefetch on hover | | **Caching** | SWR or RTK Query caching | | **CDN** | Vercel automatically serves assets via CDN | | **Service Worker** | Next.js PWA plugin (`next-pwa`) | ```tsx import Image from "next/image"; ``` --- ## 10. Testing Strategy ### 10.1 Unit & Component Tests ```bash npm install --save-dev jest @testing-library/react @testing-library/jest-dom ``` ```tsx // src/components/product/__tests__/ProductCard.test.tsx import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react"; import { ProductCard } from "../ProductCard"; test("renders product title", () => { render(); expect(screen.getByText("Test")).toBeInTheDocument(); }); ``` ### 10.2 End‑to‑End Tests ```bash npm install --save-dev cypress ``` ```js // cypress/integration/cart.spec.js describe("Cart flow", () => { it("adds item to cart", () => { cy.visit("/"); cy.contains("Add to Cart").click(); cy.contains("Cart (1)"); }); }); ``` ### 10.3 CI Integration ```yaml # .github/workflows/test.yml name: Test on: [push, pull_request] jobs: test: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v3 - uses: actions/setup-node@v3 with: node-version: 20 - run: npm ci - run: npm run test ``` --- ## 11. Deployment & CI/CD ### 11.1 Vercel (Next.js) - Connect repo → Vercel → Automatic preview deployments. - Set environment variables in Vercel dashboard (`NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`, etc.). ### 11.2 Docker (Optional) ```dockerfile # Dockerfile FROM node:20-alpine AS builder WORKDIR /app COPY package*.json ./ RUN npm ci COPY . . RUN npm run build FROM node:20-alpine WORKDIR /app COPY --from=builder /app/.next ./.next COPY --from=builder /app/public ./public COPY --from=builder /app/package*.json ./ RUN npm ci --production EXPOSE 3000 CMD ["npm", "start"] ``` ### 11.3 GitHub Actions ```yaml # .github/workflows/deploy.yml name: Deploy on: push: branches: [main] jobs: deploy: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v3 - uses: amondnet/vercel-action@v20 with: vercel-token: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }} vercel-org-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }} vercel-project-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }} vercel-args: '--prod' ``` --- ## 12. Monitoring & Analytics | Tool | Purpose | |------|---------| | **Sentry** | Runtime error tracking | | **Google Analytics 4** | User behavior, conversion tracking | | **Hotjar** | Heatmaps, session recordings | | **LogRocket** | Session replay + error logs (optional) | Add Sentry SDK: ```tsx // src/pages/_app.tsx import * as Sentry from "@sentry/react"; import { Integrations } from "@sentry/tracing"; Sentry.init({ dsn: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN, integrations: [new Integrations.BrowserTracing()], tracesSampleRate: 1.0, }); ``` --- ## 13. Security Best Practices | Practice | How | |----------|-----| | **HTTPS** | Vercel provides SSL automatically | | **CSP** | Add `Content-Security-Policy` header in `next.config.js` | | **XSS Prevention** | Escape user input, use React’s built‑in escaping | | **CSRF** | Use SameSite cookies, CSRF tokens for POST requests | | **Auth** | NextAuth.js with JWT or OAuth providers | | **Rate Limiting** | API routes with `express-rate-limit` or Vercel Edge Functions | --- ## 14. Internationalization (i18n) ```bash npm install next-i18next ``` ```js // next-i18next.config.js module.exports = { i18n: { defaultLocale: "en", locales: ["en", "es", "fr"], }, }; ``` Wrap pages with `appWithTranslation`. --- ## 15. Progressive Web App (PWA) ```bash npm install next-pwa ``` ```js // next.config.js const withPWA = require("next-pwa")({ dest: "public", register: true, skipWaiting: true, }); module.exports = withPWA({ // other config }); ``` Add a `manifest.json` in `public/`. --- ## 16. Documentation & Knowledge Sharing - **README**: Project overview, setup, scripts. - **Contributing**: Code style, commit guidelines. - **Storybook**: Live component docs. - **API Docs**: Swagger/OpenAPI for backend. - **Design System Docs**: Figma link, component usage. --- ## 17. Sample Scripts (package.json) ```json { "scripts": { "dev": "next dev", "build": "next build", "start": "next start", "lint": "eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx", "test": "jest", "e2e": "cypress open", "storybook": "start-storybook -p 6006", "build-storybook": "build-storybook" } } ``` --- ## 18. Checklist Before Launch - ✅ All core features implemented - ✅ Unit & E2E tests passing - ✅ Lighthouse score ≥ 90 (performance, accessibility, SEO) - ✅ Sentry error tracking enabled - ✅ Analytics tracking added - ✅ Dark mode & responsive design verified - ✅ SEO meta tags & structured data added - ✅ Accessibility audit passed - ✅ CI/CD pipeline running - ✅ Documentation updated --- ## 19. Resources & Further Reading | Topic | Resource | |-------|----------| | Next.js Docs | https://nextjs.org/docs | | Tailwind CSS | https://tailwindcss.com/docs | | Chakra UI | https://chakra-ui.com/docs | | RTK Query | https://redux-toolkit.js.org/api/createApi | | Lighthouse | https://developers.google.com/web/tools/lighthouse | | Sentry | https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/javascript/guides/react/ | | NextAuth.js | https://next-auth.js.org/ | | Vercel Docs | https://vercel.com/docs | | Cypress | https://docs.cypress.io/ | | Storybook | https://storybook.js.org/docs/react/get-started/introduction | --- ### Quick Start ```bash npx create-next-app@latest my-ecommerce --typescript cd my-ecommerce npm install @reduxjs/toolkit react-redux @reduxjs/toolkit-query @chakra-ui/react @emotion/react @emotion/styled framer-motion tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer npx tailwindcss init -p # Add Tailwind config, Chakra provider, Redux store, etc. ``` Follow the roadmap above to flesh out the rest. Happy coding! 🚀
